uncited: The primary distinction among siblings lies in the representation: [Isosurface Rendering](7669-isosurface-rendering.md) uses procedural ray marching for smooth, continuous appearance without explicit geometry, while [Triangular Mesh Scene Rendering](4644-triangular-mesh-scene-rendering.md) and [Optimized Mesh Reference](1888-optimized-mesh-reference.md) rely on explicit triangle meshes for standard rasterization. [Multi-Isosurface Rendering](8745-multi-isosurface-rendering.md) extends this by extracting and managing a subset of representative surfaces at different isovalue levels for interactive exploration.
